evals.prompt: Our PDM 2024 add-in should block the transition to Released when the Checked By card variable is empty but files still go through. GetAddInInfo does poCmdMgr.AddHook(EdmCmdType.EdmCmd_PostState); OnCmd: if (poCmd.meCmdType == EdmCmdType.EdmCmd_PostState) { foreach (EdmCmdData d in ppoData) { var f = (IEdmFile5)((IEdmVault5)poCmd.mpoVault).GetObject(EdmObjectType.EdmObject_File, d.mlObjectID1); object val; f.GetEnumeratorVariable().GetVar("Checked By", "@", out val); if (val == null) MessageBox.Show("Checked By is empty"); } }. fix it
evals.expected_output: Corrected add-in that hooks EdmCmd_PreState, filters on the destination state using EdmCmdData fields confirmed by lookup, treats null and empty strings as missing, cancels through poCmd.mbCancel with a user message, and explains redeployment of .NET add-ins.
expectations: Both AddHook and the OnCmd branch use EdmCmdType.EdmCmd_PreState instead of EdmCmd_PostState
Cancels the transition by setting poCmd.mbCancel
Checks the destination state name using an EdmCmdData field whose meaning is cited from the bundled docs
Treats both null and empty or whitespace strings as missing
Explains that the updated add-in must be redeployed in the Administration tool and clients restarted or Debug Add-ins used

evals.prompt: console app (C#) that logs into vault ENG_VAULT, finds every file in state Approved under \Projects\P-1042 and writes local path, revision and the Description card variable to a CSV. PDM Professional 2025
evals.expected_output: Standalone x64 tool using EdmVault5 LoginAuto, a search or folder enumeration filtered by state, GetVar for Description on the @ configuration, CurrentRevision, CSV writing and COMException decoding.
expectations: Creates the vault object and calls LoginAuto (or Login) once at start
Finds files via IEdmSearch (5 or newer) with a state filter or by enumerating IEdmFolder5 positions and checking CurrentState
Reads Description with IEdmEnumeratorVariable5.GetVar using the @ configuration
Catches COMException and reports the PDM error via GetErrorString or EdmResultErrorCodes_e

evals.prompt: need a PDM task add-in: users select drawings and run task Fill DrawnBy; the task host reads the DrawnBy and DrawnDate custom properties from each SLDDRW and writes them to the DrawnBy and DrawnDate card variables. C#, PDM Pro 2024, task host has SOLIDWORKS installed

Reports progress and final status through IEdmTaskInstance (SetProgressRange/SetProgressPos/SetStatus)
